headline: New York representative proposes bill guaranteeing video game ownership rights
summary: A New York congressman introduced a bill to guarantee video game buyers true ownership rather than just a license, following Pennsylvania's lead by requiring publishers to offer an offline mode and the ability to transfer games. Reports note the proposal still faces significant technical and legislative hurdles.

claims.statement: A New York representative, Ritchie Torres, is introducing a bill to protect video game ownership rights.

sources.quote: Representative Ritchie Torres wants the FTC to establish regulations ensuring you can play the games you've purchased.
New York rep announces game ownership bill that would require consumer ownership rather than sale of licenses
